body:
Sixth Street, a global investment firm, has formed an agreement with Lloyds to provide funding to UK commercial real estate borrowers.

Sixth Street and Lloyds agree commercial real estate funding partnership The agreement will use Sixth Street’s global asset-based finance (ABF) platform to provide financing solutions across the UK property market.

Sixth Street has formed an agreement with Lloyds to provide funding to UK commercial real estate borrowers.

Sixth Street said its London-based ABF team would work alongside its real estate team to provide flexible, scaled financing for property borrowers.

The firm’s ABF platform focuses on asset and platform investing and origination across asset-based finance markets.

The proposition will combine Sixth Street’s structuring and underwriting capabilities with its experience in acquiring, operating and underwriting real estate globally.

Sixth Street said the agreement was intended to generate further lending opportunities.
